summary: Implemented deterministic Evidence current-set resolution, supersession fail-closed validation, Completion migration to append-only Evidence history, selective verification separation of current reused versus historical excluded Evidence, and multi-Claim Defect direct/affected claim semantics.

evidence_registry: Supersession graph validation rejects duplicate refs, self-supersession, unknown refs, cycles, and competing current leaves.
Superseded records remain inspectable as historical excluded Evidence and are not deleted or mutated.
completion: evaluate_completion now resolves the EvidenceRegistry current set before evaluating required Claims.
Only current leaves with passed result and matching stored fingerprint can satisfy Claims.
Historical failed Evidence no longer blocks completion after explicit supersession.
A stale, revoked, expired, contradicted, un-fingerprinted, or resolution-failed current leaf blocks completion.
selective_verification: select_gates now operates on current leaves and exposes historicalEvidenceRefs and resolutionFailureRefs.
Reused Evidence and stale current Evidence remain separated from historical excluded Evidence.
defects: DefectRecord now emits directClaimRefs and affectedClaimRefs while retaining claimRef for compatibility.
defect_from_result computes affectedClaimRefs from ClaimGraph reverse dependency closure when a graph is supplied.
fixture_migration: Dynamic repair fixture now passes full append-only Evidence history into Completion.
Rerun Gate Evidence explicitly supersedes previous Evidence for the same Gate.
Fixture report includes current-set metrics, historical excluded Evidence refs, supersession status events, and current Claim coverage.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A passed Evidence record that supersedes a prior failed record can satisfy a Claim without deleting the failed history.
A stale/revoked/contradicted superseding record leaves the Claim uncovered and blocks Completion.
Supersession cycles, self-supersession and unknown refs fail closed.
Completion consumes the EvidenceRegistry current set instead of a caller-curated tuple.
Selective verification lists current reused Evidence and historical excluded Evidence separately.
DefectRecord supports one or more direct Claims and one or more affected Claims.
Affected Claims include deterministic reverse dependency closure or an independently validated equivalent.
Legacy Evidence remains legacy_partial and cannot silently satisfy M1 Claims.
Full checks and migration tests pass.

known_limitations: SQLite persistence remains out of scope for TASK-0035.
Unified Scheduler execution for repair PlanIR remains owned by TASK-0036.
Legacy AWKP task Evidence remains explicit legacy_partial compatibility input and is not promoted into M1 Evidence current sets.
